about: The accepted-hand payload Promo Play Through consumes, exactly as the engine sends it. The engine builds it in ServerTableEngineSettlement.postHandTasks (atomicCommit.stacks and atomicCommit.acceptedPostCommitFacts), and services/supabase/handHistory.ts forwards it unchanged as p_stacks and p_hand_row._accepted_post_commit_facts to fn_ca_commit_hand_settlement, which hands both to the promo readers. Pinned on the engine side by server/src/engine/thePromoHandCommitPayloadKeepsItsContract.test.ts (Server Engine, required). The same golden payload is fed through the promo capture by scripts/ci/test-promo-custody.py (Promo play-through lock ledger and fee meter, required). Changing a field, its name or its meaning turns the engine test red until this file changes, and this file is a promo input, so the change runs every promo proof in the same pull request.
verified_against_production: 2026-11-24, read only: the promo readers of this payload are fn_ca_promo_accept_cash_hand, fn_ca_promo_profit_capture_cash and fn_ca_promo_integrity_accept_hand (cash) and fn_ca_promo_profit_capture_tournament_hand (tournament). In the latest 500 non-tournament rake rows with a returned uncalled bet, sum(contributions) = pot in 500 of 500.

meaning.user_id: the seat's player, human or Horse alike
meaning.stack: the engine's ending stack for the hand, rounded to cents. For a tournament this excludes any between-hand add-on; the database records that as stack_result.rebased, and written = stack + rebased.
meaning.stack_before: the stack the seat was dealt with: the retained funding_stack_before when the roster has one, otherwise the dealt stack
meaning.contributions: net chips the seat left at risk in the hand: totalInvested after any uncalled bet was returned. They add up to the pot. Never subtract returned_uncalled from them.
meaning.returned_uncalled: the uncalled amount handed back to its owner. It is audit only and was never at risk.
meaning.insurance: the hand's insurance settlements; promo reads only whether the list is empty

fixture.story: Three-handed NLH. Alice (human) is dealt 50 and bets 40; Bob (a Horse, dealt 30) calls all in for 30; Dee (human, dealt 50) posted 1 and folded. Alice gets her uncalled 10 back. Bob wins the 61 pot. Alice ends on 20, Bob on 61, Dee on 49.

promo_expectation.story: All 50 of Alice's dealt stack is promo principal at the table. She ends on 20, so 30 promo chips were lost (a loss consumes a position's promo after its free chips, and she had none). The promo-funded fee exposure is the 30 chips she left at risk, not 20.
